author: Agent (Stage F follow-up), branch deployment/phase-02

timing_declaration.statement: Written and pinned BEFORE running any arm on any preregistered seed. Prior observations listed are from Stage F wiring checks and the original-protocol E4 campaign at the legacy operating point; no arm/seed combination of this study had been run when this file was written.
existing_artifacts_seen_before_preregist: P1_STAGE_F_RETINOTOPY_REPORT.md (Stage F wiring verification: optic-layer rate 2.35, focal-column selectivity, benchmark good:bad 0.00/demonAgree shift at the quick-benchmark operating point)
research_data/validation/raw_e4.csv + analysis_meta.json (original protocol, legacy 8-bin operating point: contrast -0.011, p_bh 0.928, Hedges g -0.114)

question: Does the connectome contribute measurable performance beyond degree-preserving shuffling at the retinotopic sparse-drive operating point, where the original preregistered hypothesis predicts it should apply?

arms.connectome_4A: full connectome, plasticity full, opticDrive 0.25, opticInput retinotopy
arms.connectome_4B: restricted plasticity (sensory-pathway edges only), opticDrive 0.25, opticInput retinotopy
arms.connectome_4C: degree-preserving shuffled connectome, plasticity full, opticDrive 0.25, opticInput retinotopy
arms.connectome_frozen: full connectome, plasticity none, opticDrive 0.25, opticInput retinotopy

windows.environment: nParticles 320, noise 0.12, doorHeight 64 (identical to original campaign CFG)

primary_endpoint.test: unpaired seeded permutation (10000 draws, PRNG 20260920), two-sided
primary_endpoint.success_criterion: contrast > 0 AND BH-adjusted p < 0.05 AND Hedges g >= 0.5
primary_endpoint.failure_criterion: contrast <= 0 or adjusted p >= 0.05 => 'connectome structure contributes no measurable performance at the retinotopic sparse-drive operating point' (reported verbatim if met)

secondary_endpoints: connectome_4A vs connectome_4B (plasticity scope effect) on test goodBadRatio
connectome_4A vs connectome_frozen (learning effect) on test goodBadRatio
connectome_4A learning gain (late - early train goodBadRatio, paired)
multiple_comparisons: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05 within the primary+secondary family; Holm not recomputed across experiments (other experiments not re-run)

implementation_delta.change: optional opticInput job field threaded through to E4 arm definitions (defaults preserve original behavior); physics and all other code bit-identical
